item.title: ‘Eggs Sold in India Pose No Cancer Risk’: FSSAI Shuts Down Social Media Rumours
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India on Saturday has dismissed claims linking egg consumption to cancer risk, stating that eggs sold in the country are safe and that recent reports and social media posts circulating such concerns are scientifically unsupported and misleading. The regulator said the claims were creating unnecessary public alarm without any factual basis. item.title: Hospitality to Next Level: Dubai Now Lets Hotel Guests Check-In on Their Phones
item.description: GUWAHATI: Dubai has approved the rollout of a contactless hotel check-in system that allows travellers to complete verification formalities on their mobile phones before arrival, enabling them to bypass reception desks and proceed directly to their rooms. The initiative was recently approved as part of the emirate’s push to enhance visitor experience through digital innovation. item.title: India Strikes Free Trade Deal with New Zealand to Double Bilateral Profits in Five Years
item.description: GUWAHATI: India and New Zealand on Monday, December 22, concluded a Free Trade Agreement, bringing to a close negotiations that began in March this year. The agreement was finalised following a telephone conversation between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, marking a new phase in bilateral economic relations. item.title: Assam Sends 19 Illegal Immigrants Back to Bangladesh
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam police, in coordination with the Border Security Force, have sent 19 illegal immigrants back to Bangladesh following a coordinated operation conducted in different parts of the state. The individuals had been apprehended from Nagaon and Karbi Anglong districts. item.title: Retired Bank Employees Protest in Guwahati for Updation of Pension
item.description: GUWAHATI: Retired bank employees under the banner of the North Eastern Region Bank Retirees’ Federation staged a sit-in protest at Chachal Dharna Sthal in Guwahati on Monday, December 22, demanding updation of pension. The protest was held as part of a nationwide action programme calling for resolution of long-pending pension-related issues.
